meta.title: Casket
meta.description: Quest · Data restore: continuous backup of the whole data folder; rewind to any point in time.

offsite.offDesc: Encrypted deduplicated repo: ciphertext here, spare copy on the paired device. The password never leaves this machine; after a reinstall only the recovery password works.
offsite.offUnsupported: Offsite copy needs a DSH restart (panel updated, host still on the old build).
offsite.offDisabledDesc: When enabled, the latest snapshot is encrypted and archived daily, then synced to the paired device.
offsite.offInitDesc: At least 9 characters including letters and digits. If you forget it the archive cannot be decrypted (no backdoor). The password is only used in memory and in the DPAPI cache; it is never sent to the peer.
offsite.offPasswordPlaceholder: At least 9 characters, letters and digits
offsite.offPasswordWeak: Use at least 9 characters including both letters and digits.
offsite.offInitOk: Offsite repo initialised. You can run the first export now.
offsite.offLockedDesc: Enter the recovery password to list archives and restore.
offsite.offCacheNote: A key is cached on this machine (DPAPI, only the current Windows user can decrypt it). After a reinstall only the recovery password works; run a drill weekly.
offsite.offPeerDesc: The paired peer stores ciphertext only, never the password.
offsite.offPairHint: Pair a peer in “Device sync” and keep it online to sync and restore directly over the LAN.
offsite.offArchivesEmpty: No offsite archives yet. Use “Export now” to encrypt the latest snapshot.
offsite.offRestoreNote: Missing chunks are fetched from the peer first, then the current DSH data directory is restored; DSH must be restarted afterwards.
offsite.offRestoreOk: Offsite restore finished: {n} files written. Restart DeepSeek Harness.
offsite.offDrillOk: Drill passed: sha256 matches for {files} files
offsite.offRetainDailyDesc: Keep the latest N daily archives; older ones fall back to weekly retention.
offsite.offRetainWeeklyDesc: Keep one archive per week beyond that (0 = keep none).
offsite.offQuotaDesc: Hard cap for the peer staging directory; sync is refused once exceeded.
offsite.offQuotaInvalid: Quota must be between 1 GB and 1024 GB.
offsite.offScheduleDesc: Local time HH:MM; empty means no automatic export (manual export still works).
offsite.offWeeklyDrillDesc: Restore into a temp directory once a week and verify every file; needs a cached key.
offsite.offTaskCmdDesc: Running it in an elevated PowerShell installs the daily unattended export; the panel never installs it itself.
offsite.offChainBroken: Hash chain is broken at {name}; consider exporting again.
offsite.offBusyOther: Another offsite task is already running, please wait.
offsite.offLockedHint: Unlock to list archives and restore.

monitor.monNormalDesc: A heartbeat is written every 5 seconds; crashes, data loss and backup corruption show up here as a red alert.
monitor.monUnsupported: Incident monitoring needs a DSH restart (panel updated, host still on the old build).
monitor.monBannerCrash: DSH exited unexpectedly at {time} (no clean shutdown). Recommended restore point: {snap}.
monitor.monBannerDataLoss: Data loss detected: {detail}. Recommended restore point: {snap}.
monitor.monHeartbeatDead: No heartbeat from the UI for {age}; it may be stuck
monitor.monWatchdogStale: last check was {ago} ago; it may have stopped
monitor.monNotifyHint: Panel / Windows toast / webhook / email / QQ / peer. Channels are independent; one failing never blocks the others.
monitor.monVerifyOk: Healthy: all chunks present for {n} snapshots
monitor.monInstallConfirm: This copies the watchdog and recovery console to %LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeek Recovery and registers the scheduled task DSH-DisasterWatchdog. Continue?
monitor.monInstallNote: The watchdog checks the heartbeat and process once a minute. It only records and notifies; it never restarts DSH.
monitor.monRestoreConfirmNote: A pre-restore snapshot is taken first and overwritten files go to quarantine; DSH must be restarted afterwards.
monitor.monProtectionPaused: Automatic snapshots are paused (to keep the failure state from being overwritten)
monitor.monProtectionNote: Ignoring the incident or restoring a snapshot automatically restores your previous pause state; pinned restore points are never pruned.
monitor.notifyDesc: Incident notifications are sent by the external watchdog. Panel / Windows toast / webhook / email / QQ / offsite device channels are independent and can be tested one by one.
monitor.notifyUnsupported: Notification settings need a DSH restart (panel updated, host still on the old build).
monitor.notifyWatchdogMissing: External watchdog is not installed: use “Install / repair watchdog” first
monitor.notifyTestUnavailable: External watchdog is too old: re-run “Install / repair watchdog” and test again
monitor.rootEditDesc: Must be an absolute path outside the DSH data directory and writable. Only future snapshots use it; old backups stay in the old directory.
monitor.rootConfirmNote: The profile cordis.patch.yml will be backed up and its root line rewritten; a DSH restart is required and old backups are not migrated.
monitor.rootChanged: Backup root changed to {root}; it takes effect after a DSH restart
monitor.rootPending: Pending: {root} (takes effect after DSH restart; old backups stay in the old directory)
